title: Add footer, basic admin system, and notification system

requirements.text: Add a permanent footer with the text 'Made by SC05 Sohail Ch' to all pages in the application

quotes: Footer: 'Made by SC05 Sohail Ch' har page pe permanently

acceptanceCriteria: Footer appears on all pages with the exact text 'Made by SC05 Sohail Ch'
Footer is styled consistently with the existing design
Footer remains visible at the bottom of the page

requirements.text: Implement a basic admin system that allows manually assigning admin role to specific users by their email or username

quotes: Basic Admin System: Specific users ko manually admin banane ka system (email/username se)

acceptanceCriteria: Backend provides a function to assign admin role to users by email or username
Admin status is persisted in user profiles
Only users with admin role can access admin functions like adding/editing poetry

requirements.text: Add a frontend interface for manually assigning admin privileges to users by email or username

quotes: Aap specific users ko admin bana sakte hain (manually email/username se)

acceptanceCriteria: Admin panel includes a form to assign admin role by entering email or username
Form provides feedback on successful admin assignment
Only existing admins can access this admin assignment interface

requirements.text: Implement in-app notification system that notifies logged-in users when new poetry is added to the platform

quotes: Notification System: Nayi poetry add hone pe logged-in users ko in-app notifications

acceptanceCriteria: When a new poem is added, all logged-in users receive an in-app notification
Notifications appear in the existing NotificationBell component
Notification message clearly indicates that new poetry has been added
Users can mark notifications as read

constraints: Use the existing notification system infrastructure (NotificationBell, NotificationPanel components)
Maintain the existing access control and authorization patterns from backend/main.mo
Preserve the current Internet Identity authentication flow
